facts.big: How do I…? · Do I put…?
facts.label: Usar o caixa sozinho
facts.sub: Pergunte How do I scan the milk? e Do I put the milk in a bag? Entenda Hold the barcode under the light. Pergunte Where does it go? e How do I get the receipt?

facts.label: Autoatendimento
facts.sub: Muitos mercados dos EUA têm caixas de autoatendimento. Você escaneia cada produto, coloca na sacola e paga. Um funcionário fica por perto para ajudar se a máquina apitar.

facts.label: Cupons
facts.sub: Cupons dão desconto em produtos. Eles vêm em jornais, no celular ou no recibo. Você escaneia o cupom no caixa, e o valor é tirado do total da compra.

pages.title: Scan it, then pay · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday morning at a big supermarket in Denver. The lines at the cashier are very long today. Leo has only a few groceries, so he walks to the self-checkout. He is holding a carton of milk and a paper coupon. The machine has a small screen and a red light. A friendly worker named Nora walks over to him.
“Hi! Do you need help with the machine?” says Nora. “Yes. How do I scan the milk?” says Leo. “Hold the barcode under the red light.” says Nora.

pages.title: Scan it, then pay · 3/3
paragraphs: “Great. Is the total on the screen, and can I pay by card?” says Leo. “Yes to both. Have a nice day!” says Nora. Leo scans the barcode and the machine beeps. He puts the milk in the bag on the scale. The coupon takes two dollars off the total. He pays by card and waits for a moment. The receipt comes out of the slot, long and thin. Leo takes his bag and walks out with a smile.
